from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544661/attempts/14aed0dece444fbc9ee55e057cb0e219/system/state/workspace/programs/task-19f5fedd.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text('def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    color = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    rows = [i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if any(v == color for v in row)]
    for i in rows[1:]:
        end = max(j for j,v in enumerate(grid[i]) if v == color) + 1
        for j in range(end, len(grid[i])):
            out[i][j] = 1
    return out
')
